capabilities: Select multiple tabs with shift-click and control-click
Close selected tabs with middle click or hotkey
Open a context menu acting on selected tabs
Drag selected tabs to another tab group or window
Undo tab closes to restore closed tabs
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Select and control multiple tabs with intuitive inputs, inspired by browsers like Firefox.
problem: Obsidian tabs are handled one at a time, so selecting, closing, or moving many tabs requires doing each one separately.
summary: Browser-style multi-tab selection that adds shift-click range selection, control-click toggling, and group actions for tabs.
